title: Financial Times ownership and control
summary: The Financial Times is a UK-based international business and news publication. Its publisher, The Financial Times Limited, is controlled by Financial Times Group Limited, whose parent is Japan’s Nikkei Inc. Nikkei reported 100% of FT Group’s voting rights at 31 December 2025. The graph stops at Nikkei at the three-relationship limit.

gaps: Recent-sale searches found no subsequent disposal. Current FT corporate disclosures support continued Nikkei ownership, but the latest dated parent-company observation used here is 31 December 2025.
The accessible explicit publisher masthead dates from October 2023. FT legal and editorial-code pages could not be opened successfully.
The Financial Times Limited’s exact equity and voting percentages were not established; Companies House provides bands of 75% or more.
FT Group’s register states that it has no registrable person or relevant legal entity. This registration statement does not negate the Nikkei parent relationship disclosed in Nikkei’s annual report.
Nikkei’s shareholders and any separate editorial appointment rights were not mapped within the three-level limit.
No Wikidata identifiers were verified. All findings are unreviewed.
